description: Slack integration for the OSS desktop app - FULLY LOCAL (local DB, no backend, no cloud). Build a self-contained Slack client, normalize Slack threads into the existing LOCAL conversation pipeline (reuse the local conversation -> task path; do NOT rebuild analysis), paste-token auth (NO OAuth), a local settings UI inside the EXISTING integrations area, and a polling loop. Ingestion unit = a Slack thread, processed after a configurable quiet period (default 60 min, user-configurable); loose top-level messages batched per channel per poll window. Wiser-note write is a PLACEHOLDER entry point (no auto-firing). ACTIVE PRD: ralph/slack-integration ONLY. Do NOT add stories or expand scope. Electron + TypeScript. Verify behavior in the running desktop app (renderer), not a public browser URL. Use typecheck + app render to verify.

userStories.title: Local Slack API client
userStories.description: As the desktop app, I need a local Slack client for channels, history, threads, and posting.
acceptanceCriteria: Client exposes listChannels(), getChannelHistory(channelId, sinceCursor), getThreadReplies(channelId, ts), postMessage(channelId, text)
Runs locally with a user-provided bot token; no cloud/backend calls
Handles pagination and 429 / Retry-After backoff
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Paste-token auth + local storage
userStories.description: As a user, I want to connect Slack by pasting a bot token, stored locally.
acceptanceCriteria: Settings field accepts a bot token and validates it via auth.test
Token stored in the local DB consistent with how OSS stores other keys
Valid token shows connected state; invalid token shows a clear error
No OAuth flow is added
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Slack message normalizer to local conversation
userStories.description: As the local pipeline, I need Slack threads mapped into the existing local conversation object.
acceptanceCriteria: Maps a Slack thread (parent + replies) into the same local conversation object the existing local task pipeline consumes
Resolves Slack user IDs to names; attaches channel + permalink metadata
Existing local conversation -> task path accepts it unchanged
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Ingestion batching + quiet-period debounce
userStories.description: As a user, I do not want half-finished threads processed.
acceptanceCriteria: A thread is processed only after it has been quiet for the configured inactivity window (default 60 min)
Loose top-level messages batched per channel per poll window
A settled thread that later gets a new reply is reprocessed
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Ingestion cursor + local dedup
userStories.description: As the app, I must not re-ingest messages, and Slack tasks must dedup like meeting tasks.
acceptanceCriteria: Per-channel last-seen cursor persisted locally; re-fetch starts from the cursor
Slack-sourced tasks route through the existing local dedup
Re-running ingestion on an unchanged channel creates zero new conversations/tasks
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Wiser-note write interface (placeholder)
userStories.description: As Wiser, I want a local entry point to post a note to a selected channel, with no auto-firing.
acceptanceCriteria: postWiserNote(channelId, note) posts a formatted note via the local client to a channel in the write list
Wired but inert: no code path posts automatically in this PRD
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Local settings UI: channels + inactivity window
userStories.description: As a user, I want to pick read/write channels and the inactivity window inside the existing integrations area.
acceptanceCriteria: Slack appears in the existing local integrations area, consistent with other integrations
Read-channels and write-channels multi-selects, plus an inactivity-window control (default 60 min)
Selections + window persist locally and reload correctly
Typecheck passes
Verify in the running desktop app

userStories.title: Polling loop
userStories.description: As a user, I want selected channels polled while the app is open so new conversations flow in.
acceptanceCriteria: Timer-based poll over selected channels using the cursor (US-005); configurable interval with a sensible default
New messages run through normalize (US-003) -> batch/debounce (US-004) -> existing local task pipeline
Runs while the app is open and resumes from the last cursor on restart (no re-ingest of old messages)
Typecheck passes
Verify in the running desktop app
